meta.notes: Legal entity: website privacy policy (https://zaka.vc/privacy-policy/) names 'ZAKA VC I, osoba rizikového kapitálu, a.s., ID number: 215 14 992', seat Italská 2581/67, Prague 2 (a second paragraph gives Panská 854/2, Prague 1; ARES confirms Italská 2581/67). Policy says it is a risk-capital entity listed with the CNB under s.596(e) ZISIF (not supervised); not checked in JERRS. Two other ZAKA entities in ARES (ZAKA Management s.r.o. 21053987, Praha 2; ZAKA Holding s.r.o. 17614597, Heralec) are not named on the site, so not recorded. Fund size conflict: about page says Fund I sized EUR 15M (used); homepage shows '17M' with no currency label. Fund I vintage 2024 from 'Since 2024'. Sectors: portfolio is mostly biotech; 'Industrial Tech' mapped to industrial_manufacturing. Sygaldry quote is the dated post on investor's own site (self-reported); Cirrus and DeepSeq are the investor's own press-release posts. Several more 2025-2026 deals listed on zaka.vc/news (e.g. ParcelBio, Sensible Biotechnologies follow-on), not recorded.
